content_sections.heading: IMU Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: School of Marine Engineering and Technology
Study on National Waterway Quality and Tidal Influence on Corrosion Insights for Inland Vessel Maintenance: Toward Efficient Dry Docking and Maritime Vision 2047
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (MoPSW)
Maximum 3 years or till the completion of project tenure (whichever is earlier)
30 years for GEN/GEN-EWS, 33 years for OBC-NCL, 35 years for SC/ST/PwD as on 1 November 2026

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential educational qualifications from a recognized university or institute with a strong academic record. The required qualifications are: M.E./M.Tech. with First Class in Marine Engineering, Marine Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Production Engineering, or a closely related discipline. AND B.E./B.Tech. with First Class in Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Production Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Desirable Qualifications: Knowledge in optimization techniques, AI & ML modelling, Image Processing, MATLAB, Simulation, and corrosion analysis. Having research articles published in peer-reviewed journals indexed in Scopus or WoS is considered desirable. Age Limits and Relaxation: The upper age limit is 30 years for the GEN/GEN-EWS category, 33 years for OBC-NCL candidates, and 35 years for SC/ST/PwD candidates, calculated as on 1st November 2026.

content_sections.heading: IMU Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate is required to perform the following duties: Conduct field visits and collect water samples from different national waterways. Perform analysis of water samples and study corrosion influences on metals. Carry out modelling, simulation, and prediction analysis using the collected data. Handle the procurement of equipment and conduct experiments related to the research project. Interpret research results and prepare reports required for the successful execution of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Download and complete the application form provided at the end of the official notification. Prepare a brief resume, curriculum vitae, or bio-data. Compile the completed application form, CV, and scanned copies of all educational certificates into a single PDF file. Submit the application via the official Google form link. Email the single PDF file containing all documents to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be screened by the selection committee. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which may be conducted in offline or online mode, and will be intimated via email. No TA or DA will be paid to candidates attending an offline interview. The decision of the selection committee remains final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the IMU Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position under the sponsored research project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IMU JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email and the Google form is 12/11/2026, which may be extended if desired applications are not received.

faq.question: Q3. What educational qualifications are required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold both an M.E./M.Tech. degree and a B.E./B.Tech. degree with First Class in Marine Engineering, Marine Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Production Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for GEN candidates?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years for GEN and GEN-EWS category candidates as on 1st November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly stipend offered for this JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected fellow receives Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA per month for the first two years, and Rs. 42,000/- plus HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job at Indian Maritime University?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure, initially posted for 6 months and extendable based on performance and funds.

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances paid on top of the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: Yes, House Rent Allowance (HRA) is paid in addition to the specified monthly stipend amounts for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Upper age relaxation is provided up to 33 years for OBC-NCL candidates and up to 35 years for SC, ST, and PwD candidates as on 1st November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected for the position?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected through shortlisting of applications followed by an interview (offline or online), and only shortlisted individuals are notified by email.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents must be submitted along with the application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must submit a brief resume, curriculum vitae, or bio-data along with scanned copies of all educational certificates combined into a single PDF file.
